apps.name: Home Assistant
apps.description: Open-source home automation for lights, climate, sensors, and scenes. Talks to hundreds of devices on your LAN so you keep the automations, not a cloud vendor.
apps.compose:
services:
  homeassistant:
    image: ghcr.io/home-assistant/home-assistant:stable
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8123:8123"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro

apps.name: ESPHome
apps.tagline: Firmware and management for ESP devices
apps.description: Build and flash firmware for ESP8266 and ESP32 devices from a browser. Pair with Home Assistant for local sensors, switches, and displays you control.
apps.compose:
services:
  esphome:
    image: ghcr.io/esphome/esphome:stable
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "6052:6052"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro

apps.name: Zigbee2MQTT
apps.description: Bridge Zigbee bulbs, locks, and sensors to MQTT without a vendor hub. Exposes every device as a local topic your automations can subscribe to.
apps.compose:
services:
  zigbee2mqtt:
    image: koenkk/zigbee2mqtt
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data
      - /run/udev:/run/udev:ro

apps.name: Node-RED
apps.description: Drag-and-drop flows that wire IoT devices, APIs, and timers together. Useful for custom automations that sit beside Home Assistant or MQTT.
apps.compose:
services:
  nodered:
    image: nodered/node-red:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "1880:1880"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data

apps.name: Mosquitto
apps.description: A small MQTT broker for device telemetry and command topics. The message bus most homelab automations share.
apps.compose:
services:
  mosquitto:
    image: eclipse-mosquitto:2
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "1883:1883"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/mosquitto/config
      - ./data:/mosquitto/data
      - ./log:/mosquitto/log

apps.name: Matter
apps.description: Official Matter controller used with Home Assistant. Commission Thread and Wi-Fi Matter devices on the LAN without a vendor hub.
apps.compose:
services:
  matter-server:
    image: ghcr.io/home-assistant-libs/python-matter-server:stable
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5580:5580"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data

apps.name: Pi-hole
apps.description: Network-wide DNS ad and tracker blocking for every device on the LAN. Also gives you query logs and optional DHCP on the same box.
apps.compose:
services:
  pihole:
    image: pihole/pihole:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"
    volumes:
      - ./etc-pihole:/etc/pihole
    environment:
      TZ: "Asia/Dubai"
      FTLCONF_webserver_api_enabled: "true"
      FTLCONF_dns_listeningMode: "all"

apps.name: AdGuard Home
apps.tagline: DNS ad blocker and parental controls
apps.description: DNS-level ad blocking plus parental controls and per-client rules. A full-featured alternative to Pi-hole with a modern web UI.
apps.compose:
services:
  adguard:
    image: adguard/adguardhome
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./work:/opt/adguardhome/work
      - ./conf:/opt/adguardhome/conf

apps.name: Nginx Proxy Manager
apps.tagline: Easy reverse proxy with SSL UI
apps.description: Point hostnames at containers and issue Let’s Encrypt certificates from a form. Reverse proxy without hand-editing nginx configs.
apps.compose:
services:
  npm:
    image: jc21/nginx-proxy-manager:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "81:81"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
      - ./letsencrypt:/etc/letsencrypt

apps.name: Traefik
apps.description: Cloud-native edge router that discovers Docker services and routes HTTPS to them. Labels on a container become live routes.
apps.compose:
services:
  traefik:
    image: traefik:v3.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - ./traefik.yml:/etc/traefik/traefik.yml:ro

apps.name: WireGuard Easy
apps.tagline: WireGuard VPN with a web UI
apps.description: WireGuard VPN with a simple web UI for peers and configs. Reach the homelab from phones and laptops without exposing every port.
apps.compose:
services:
  wg-easy:
    image: ghcr.io/wg-easy/wg-easy
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "51821:51821"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/etc/wireguard
    environment:
      WG_HOST: "192.168.0.40"
      PASSWORD: "changeme"

apps.name: Cloudflare Tunnel
apps.tagline: Publish services online without opening ports
apps.description: Cloudflare connector for this host. Link your account in Settings, then publish a service only when you choose to put it on the public internet. Control Center stays on the LAN.
apps.compose:
services:
  cloudflared:
    image: cloudflare/cloudflared:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: tunnel --no-autoupdate run

apps.name: Jellyfin
apps.description: Free software media server for movies, TV, and music. Streams to browsers, apps, and TVs with no license fee or tracking.
apps.compose:
services:
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8096:8096"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ./cache:/cache
      - ./media:/media

apps.name: Immich
apps.description: Self-hosted photo and video backup with mobile upload and a timeline. A private stand-in for Google Photos on your own disk.
apps.compose: # See https://github.com/immich-app/immich/releases/latest/download/docker-compose.yml

apps.name: Navidrome
apps.description: Lightweight Subsonic-compatible music server for a local library. Streams to web and mobile clients with a small memory footprint.
apps.compose:
services:
  navidrome:
    image: deluan/navidrome:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "4533:4533"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
      - ./music:/music:ro

apps.name: Audiobookshelf
apps.description: Audiobook and podcast server with progress sync across devices. Keeps libraries, series, and listening position on the LAN.
apps.compose:
services:
  audiobookshelf:
    image: ghcr.io/advplyr/audiobookshelf:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "13378:80"
    volumes:
      - ./audiobooks:/audiobooks
      - ./podcasts:/podcasts
      - ./config:/config

apps.name: Kavita
apps.description: Server for comics, manga, and ebooks with progress sync. Point it at a library folder and read in the browser or apps.
apps.compose:
services:
  kavita:
    image: jvmilazz0/kavita:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5000:5000"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/kavita/config

apps.name: Sonarr
apps.description: Watches RSS and indexers to collect TV series into your library. Pairs with download clients and Prowlarr for a full *arr stack.
apps.compose:
services:
  sonarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8989:8989"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ./tv:/tv

apps.name: Radarr
apps.description: Movie collection manager that finds, grabs, and organizes films. Same workflow as Sonarr, aimed at a movie library.
apps.compose:
services:
  radarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/radarr:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "7878:7878"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ./movies:/movies

apps.name: Prowlarr
apps.description: One indexer manager for Sonarr, Radarr, and the rest of the *arr apps. Add indexers once and share them across the stack.
apps.compose:
services:
  prowlarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/prowlarr:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9696:9696"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config

apps.name: Uptime Kuma
apps.description: Self-hosted uptime checks with a status page and alerts. Watch HTTP, ping, and Docker targets from one dashboard.
apps.compose:
services:
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data

apps.name: Grafana
apps.description: Build metrics dashboards and alert rules on top of Prometheus or other stores. The usual front end for homelab graphs.
apps.compose:
services:
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana-oss
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/lib/grafana

apps.name: Prometheus
apps.description: Pulls and stores time-series metrics from exporters. The scrape-and-query backend Grafana panels usually read.
apps.compose:
services:
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
      - ./data:/prometheus

apps.name: Netdata
apps.description: Real-time per-second charts for CPU, disks, network, and containers. Fast health view of a single host without a big stack.
apps.compose:
services:
  netdata:
    image: netdata/netdata:stable
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "19999:19999"
    volumes:
      - netdataconfig:/etc/netdata
      - netdatalib:/var/lib/netdata
      - netdatacache:/var/cache/netdata

apps.name: Speedtest Tracker
apps.description: Runs scheduled internet speed tests and keeps a history. Shows download, upload, and ping trends on the dashboard widget.
apps.compose:
services:
  speedtest-tracker:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/speedtest-tracker:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8444:80"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config

apps.name: Beszel
apps.description: Lightweight hub for server and container stats across hosts. Smaller footprint than a full Prometheus stack when you just need basics.
apps.compose:
services:
  beszel:
    image: henrygd/beszel:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8090:8090"
    volumes:
      - ./beszel_data:/beszel_data

apps.name: Glances
apps.tagline: Linux process list, CPU, and RAM
apps.description: Browser task list for this Linux host: CPU, RAM, and running processes. Install uses host PID so you see the machine, not only the container.
apps.compose:
services:
  glances:
    image: nicolargo/glances:latest-full
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "61208:61208"
    pid: host
    environment:
      GLANCES_OPT: "-w"

apps.name: Changedetection.io
apps.description: Watch URLs for text or visual changes and get notified. Useful for product pages, docs, and status posts you do not want to refresh by hand.
apps.compose:
services:
  changedetection:
    image: ghcr.io/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5001:5000"
    volumes:
      - ./datastore:/datastore

apps.name: Nextcloud
apps.description: Self-hosted files, calendars, and collaboration in the browser. Dropbox-style sync that stays on your disks.
apps.compose:
services:
  nextcloud:
    image: nextcloud:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./nextcloud:/var/www/html

apps.name: Syncthing
apps.description: Continuous peer-to-peer file sync with no central server. Folders stay in lockstep across PCs, NAS, and phones.
apps.compose:
services:
  syncthing:
    image: syncthing/syncthing:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8384:8384"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/var/syncthing/config
      - ./data:/var/syncthing

apps.name: Paperless-ngx
apps.description: Scan, OCR, and archive documents into a searchable library. Tags, correspondents, and full-text search for household paper.
apps.compose: # See https://docs.paperless-ngx.com/setup/#docker

apps.name: File Browser
apps.description: Web file manager for a directory on the host. Upload, download, and share files without standing up a full cloud suite.
apps.compose:
services:
  filebrowser:
    image: filebrowser/filebrowser:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./srv:/srv
      - ./config:/config

apps.name: Portainer
apps.description: Web UI for Docker containers, images, volumes, and stacks. Day-to-day container chores without living in the CLI.
apps.compose:
services:
  portainer:
    image: portainer/portainer-ce:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9443:9443"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - ./data:/data

apps.name: Dockge
apps.description: Compose-stack manager with a clean editor and logs. Aimed at people who keep services as docker-compose.yml files.
apps.compose:
services:
  dockge:
    image: louislam/dockge:1
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5001:5001"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - ./data:/app/data
      - ./stacks:/opt/stacks

apps.name: Coolify
apps.tagline: Self-hosted PaaS for apps and databases
apps.description: Self-hosted PaaS for apps, databases, and deploys. Push a repo or a compose file and get HTTPS and restarts handled.
apps.compose: # Install via https://coolify.io/docs/get-started/installation

apps.name: Vaultwarden
apps.description: Unofficial Bitwarden-compatible password manager. Official apps and browser extensions talk to your own server.
apps.compose:
services:
  vaultwarden:
    image: vaultwarden/server:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data

apps.name: Authentik
apps.description: Identity provider with SSO, applications, and policies. Front the homelab with one login instead of a password per service.
apps.compose: # See https://docs.goauthentik.io/docs/install-config/install/docker-compose

apps.name: Authelia
apps.description: SSO and 2FA portal that sits in front of reverse-proxied apps. Lightweight companion to Nginx Proxy Manager or Traefik.
apps.compose:
services:
  authelia:
    image: authelia/authelia:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9091:9091"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config

apps.name: Gitea
apps.description: Self-hosted Git with issues, PRs, and a web UI. A small GitHub stand-in for private repos on the LAN.
apps.compose:
services:
  gitea:
    image: gitea/gitea:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
      - /etc/timezone:/etc/timezone:ro
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro

apps.name: n8n
apps.description: Workflow automation that connects APIs, webhooks, and schedules. Build integrations without writing a service for each one.
apps.compose:
services:
  n8n:
    image: docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5678:5678"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/home/node/.n8n

apps.name: Actual Budget
apps.description: Local-first envelope budgeting that syncs through your own server. Money data stays on disk, not at a bank-adjacent SaaS.
apps.compose:
services:
  actual-server:
    image: actualbudget/actual-server:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5006:5006"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
    environment:
      ACTUAL_PORT: "5006"
      ACTUAL_HOSTNAME: "::"

apps.name: Securo
apps.description: Self-hosted personal finance: accounts, transactions, budgets, and optional bank sync. Install starts Postgres, Redis, and Celery; first login is Securo’s own setup screen.
apps.compose:
services:
  securo:
    image: ghcr.io/securo-finance/securo-frontend:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3030:8080"

apps.name: Mealie
apps.description: Recipe manager and meal planner with import from the web. Shopping lists and household recipes in one place.
apps.compose:
services:
  mealie:
    image: ghcr.io/mealie-recipes/mealie:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9925:9000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data

apps.name: Linkding
apps.description: Minimal bookmark manager with tags, search, and a browser extension. A private pinboard that stays on this host.
apps.compose:
services:
  linkding:
    image: sissbruecker/linkding:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/etc/linkding/data

apps.name: Stirling-PDF
apps.tagline: Edit, merge, and convert PDFs locally
apps.description: Merge, split, OCR, and convert PDFs in the browser. Files stay on the LAN instead of a cloud editor.
apps.compose:
services:
  stirling-pdf:
    image: docker.stirlingpdf.com/stirlingtools/stirling-pdf:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./configs:/configs

apps.name: IT-Tools
apps.tagline: Handy web tools for encoding, hashing, and text
apps.description: A drawer of small utilities: Base64, hashes, UUID, lorem, and more. Stateless and light enough for a Pi.
apps.compose:
services:
  it-tools:
    image: ghcr.io/corentinth/it-tools:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8780:80"

apps.name: Wallos
apps.description: Track subscriptions and recurring costs with reminders. See where the monthly money goes without a spreadsheet.
apps.compose:
services:
  wallos:
    image: ghcr.io/ellite/wallos:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8282:80"
    volumes:
      - ./db:/var/www/html/db

apps.name: Open WebUI
apps.tagline: Chat UI for local and remote AI models
apps.description: Chat UI for Ollama and other OpenAI-compatible models. Does not install Ollama; run that on the host if you want local models.
apps.compose:
services:
  open-webui:
    image: ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3000:8080"
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/backend/data
    environment:
      OLLAMA_BASE_URL: "http://host.docker.internal:11434"

apps.name: BookStack
apps.description: Wiki organized as books, chapters, and pages. Install creates a MariaDB sidecar and sets the public URL for this host.
apps.compose:
services:
  bookstack:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/bookstack:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "6875:80"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config

apps.name: Odysseus
apps.tagline: Self-hosted AI workspace for chat, agents, and research
apps.description: Self-hosted AI workspace for chat, agents, and research. Install builds from Git and starts Chroma, SearXNG, and ntfy. Point it at host Ollama if you have it.
apps.compose:
services:
  odysseus:
    image: cc-odysseus:local
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "7000:7000"
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
